Rebar Visibility Control

Put reinforcement in view. Get back to the review.

Show, hide, and restore reinforcement in Revit plan, section, and 3D views from a dedicated control.

Request Demo on WhatsApp Compare Workflows
Key features

Keep the view focused on the current coordination question

Reinforcement can help or obscure a review depending on what you are checking. Switch it on for the reinforcement discussion and restore visibility when you move on.

  • 01

    Show or hide all rebar in any view

    3D, Plan, or Section — in a single click

  • 02

    No need to manually navigate Visibility/Graphic Overrides per view

  • 03

    Supports batch application across multiple views simultaneously

  • 04

    Restores rebar to its natural visible state with correct display settings

  • 05

    Essential during coordination reviews and clash detection sessions

Workflow comparison

Manual Revit vs. Rebar Visibility Control

TaskManual Revit workflowWith Rebar Visibility Control
Change rebar visibilityManual Revit workflowOpen Visibility/Graphics in the view and change the relevant setting.With Rebar Visibility ControlUse the show or hide action in the tool.
Handle multiple review viewsManual Revit workflowRepeat the change in each view that needs it.With Rebar Visibility ControlApply the same visibility action to the selected views together.
Restore visibilityManual Revit workflowRevisit the affected views after the review.With Rebar Visibility ControlUse the restore action and check the resulting view.

1–2 min

Open the view settings, change the rebar display, and check it.
